blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — State witness and former Public Works Undersecretary Henry Alcantara on Tuesday told the Sandiganbayan that he got a 2 percent cut as “lambing” (gentle request) from alleged kickbacks for former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co. Alcantara mentioned this in testimony before the anti-graft court’s Third Division during former House Speaker Martin Romualdez’s bail hearing for his plunder case. The former speaker’s charge stems from alleged kickbacks from infrastructure projects worth P7.44 billion. According to Alcantara, he submitted a list of projects to former Ako Bicol Rep.
